paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The difference between probing a single layer and probing the weighted sum of layers. concat is the concatenation of all layers. 0 is the embedding layer. Large negative values on the y-axis mean that probing the particular layer on the x-axis is much worse than probing the weighted sum of all layers.

annotations.annotation: The bar charts illustrate the percent point difference across various layers of two models, mBERT and XLM-R, with each chart focusing on one model. The horizontal axis of each chart represents the layers numbered from 0 to 12, with an additional category labeled "concat". The value axis is vertical, labeled "% point difference", with a linear scale ranging from -10 to 0, marked at intervals of 2 percent points. In the mBERT chart, the bars are colored in light blue, with the shortest bars at layers 9, and 10, approximately at 0, and the tallest bar at layer 0, exceeding -10. The XLM-R chart features dark blue bars, with the shortest bars around layer 12, approximately reaching 0, and the tallest at layer 0, 1 about near -10. The bars are sorted sequentially by layer number, with no bars visually emphasized or annotated. The arrangement of the charts is uniform, without any groupings or stacks, and the data is presented without additional visual emphasis. Both the bar plots follow similar pattern overall, except few. No legend is given.
